glasgow_boutique_keeper.text: How's it going? Take a look about. The Merchant City was built on tobacco, but we sell better things.

then.text: That {worn_coat} has class. Glasgow folk notice a good coat. We have to, with the weather.
The {worn_hat} suits you. I'd buy it off you if it wasn't so obviously yours.
That {worn_top} is a smart wee thing.
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: Come on, there's a wardrobe in here with your name on it. Possibly a kilt.

glasgow_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
